Our Signature
Our Philosophy
We are in the business of creating moments. This requires an obsessive level of attention to our guests' needs—both spoken and unspoken. We find the friction points of travel and smooth them over with creative solutions. Our philosophy isn't found in a handbook; it's found in the eyes of our staff as they anticipate your next question.
Creating moments that
Make memories.
The best service is the kind you didn't you know you needed until it arrived.
A Different Approach
Guests come here to experience something together. Moments that feel a little unexpected, a little easier, and a lot more memorable. It’s the kind of place people talk about long after they leave, because the experience doesn’t fade once the trip is over.
Every interaction is an opportunity to craft a story. We don't just facilitate stays; we curate intentional moments. It is the unexpected gesture, the small surprise that breaks the rhythm of travel, that truly shapes the narrative of your journey.
Why We Do It
Travel is a profound part of the human experience. We do this to support families, to remove small stresses, and to ensure that when you look back on your Hollywood trip, you remember the joy, not the logistics.
The Heart of the Hotel
The Origin Story
Our journey began with Darren, whose roots in hospitality and brand-building run deep. His father, the President of the legendary Famous Amos Cookies, taught him early on that a brand isn’t only the thing you sell — it’s how people feel when they experience it.
At 15, working at Baskin-Robbins, Darren began to see how quickly a simple interaction could shift someone’s mood. A few small things — acknowledging someone, moving with purpose, creating a moment of connection — could turn an ordinary transaction into something memorable. It wasn’t about the ice cream. It was about how people felt when they walked away.
That idea stayed with him.
Over time, he also saw that much of high-end hospitality focused heavily on presentation and process, but often missed that same human element—the part that actually makes an experience stick.
In 2003, he brought that perspective to the Magic Castle Hotel ® . Rather than relying on the building itself, he chose to focus entirely on the guest experience. How each moment feels, how each interaction lands.
The result is what you see today: a hotel shaped less by the structure and more by the moments that happen inside it, where the stay feels less like a transaction and more like a story unfolding.
Learn More
What You Can Expect
There are many places to stay in Los Angeles. This one becomes part of your story. Join us in Hollywood for a stay designed around you.
Space to Settle In Apartment-Style layouts designed for comfort and privacy. Separate spaces for parents and kids to relax, recharge, and truly unwind.
An Attentive Team From the moment you arrive, you’re welcomed with a sparkling drink and a team ready to make your stay easy, relaxed, and fun.
The Hotel You'll Remember You get the flexibility, personal attention, and thoughtful touches that come from staying at a small, independent hotel, the kind you’ll remember long after you leave.

The hollywood experience
Walkable Hollywood
Step out our front door and find yourself minutes away from the energy of Hollywood’s most iconic landmarks. No car required for these legendary sights.
Walk of Fame Trace the history of cinema right beneath your feet.
Chinese & Dolby Theatres Home to the Oscars and Hollywood’s biggest premieres.
Dining & Nightlife Nearby Musso & Frank Grill and a dozen artisan cafes await.
Location Tip Most guests find they can explore 80% of Hollywood's major attractions entirely on foot from our lobby.
our Backyard Studio
Universal Access
A mere 7-minute drive or a quick Metro ride takes you to the gates of Universal Studios. Experience the thrills of the park knowing that a quiet, comfortable retreat is just moments away when you’re ready to recharge.
A Must See Go behind the scenes on the World-Famous Studio Tour
Movies - Brought to Life Wizarding World of Harry Potter, The Walking Dead Attraction, Waterworld, Universal's Animal Actors.
Never a Dull Moment Shops, restaurants, and rides. 19-screen Universal Cinema at CityWalk.
"The ease of getting back to the hotel mid-day for a quick rest was the highlight of our trip. Truly seamless." ~ The Miller Family
exclusive access
Next Door to Magic
We are the primary neighbor to the world-famous Magic Castle ™ Private Club. Established in 1963, this Victorian mansion is the heart of the magic world. Guests who book directly with us enjoy rare, exclusive access to this private sanctuary.
Discover Private Access
Location Tip Guests who book directly with us or with a travel agent receive access to the most exclusive club in Los Angeles - The World-Famous Magic Castle ™ .
Home sweet home
Come Back to Fun
After a day of navigating the energy and ambition of Hollywood, there is nothing quite like returning to our gates. It's a place where the pace slows down, the service is personal, and the city's noise simply fades away. Reset, have an ice cream cone, relax, and prepare for tomorrow's adventure.
Refresh and relax Complimentary snacks & refreshments always waiting.
A Central Base for Your Visit
LA is a collection of villages. From our central Hollywood location, you are perfectly positioned to strike out in any direction. Santa Monica's beaches are to the west, Downtown's cultural hub is to the east, and the charm of Pasadena is just north. We make managing the city effortless.
Wow this place is magical in so many ways. From the moment you walk in and all throughout our stay we were greeted by the most friendly and helpful staff who will go out of their way to make sure your stay is magical.

Our Sanctuaries
Rooms Designed for How You Actually Travel
Choose the setup that fits your trip, whether you're traveling with kids, as a couple, or as a group.

Our Rooms
Most hotel rooms force trade-offs. Someone gets the couch. Space feels tight. Meals are take-out or costly restaurants.Here, the rooms are part of what makes the trip easier. You’ll have space to spread out, options for meals, and room to actually relax at the end of the day.
With 39 rooms to choose from, you'll find the perfect fit. Here are our 5 main room configurations.
Single Queen
Sleeps up to two
A straightforward room for when you don’t need extra space. Comfortable, efficient, just right for couples. Your traditional single room is everything you expect: Queen-size bed, a desk, mini-fridge and pots of free coffee.
